About

Zaen Skin is an Algerian bodycare brand inspired by North African beauty rituals, natural ingredients and cultural heritage. With a contemporary approach to skincare, the brand celebrates the connection between tradition and modernity.

For Zaen Skin's first collection, inspired by the scents of the Sahara, we developed its entire visual universe, from logo creation and typography to packaging design, art direction and campaign photography.
